files.scope: Coworker creation transaction journal, exact raw-state recovery, startup/retry recovery gate
Isolated Chromium overlay harness; candidate default, --baseline and --integrated modes

tests.result: Expected failing-before evidence: baseline leaves an orphan coworker after chat write failure and does not preserve raw state.

Five candidate scenarios passed: rich-state preservation on preferences/chat/docs failures, persistent rollback failure plus blocked retry and startup recovery, same-name retry, duplicate rejection, and local welcome checks.
Current live project is still baseline; integrated mode is intentionally an exact post-merge rerun path and currently reproduces the defect.
Five replacements each matched exactly once during root integration; integration.json records all hashes.

limitations: The harness uses isolated Chromium, a static file overlay and blocked non-static requests; it does not exercise a real provider, device, credential or user-storage path.
The persistent rollback scenario uses a controlled failure on the rollback write; browser localStorage writes are synchronous and atomic per key, while cross-key recovery is journaled.
The live integrated project remains unchanged until the root agent applies the exact replacements.
Some UI handlers can mutate unsaved in-memory state while persistent writes are blocked. Verification covers saved-state preservation and recovery.
